cases.sentence: Я забросаю ваши лица навозом ваших ___, и вас выбросят вместе с ним .
cases.explain: «праздничных жертв» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

cases.sentence: В его устах было ___, и с языка его не слетало лжи.
cases.explain: «истинное учение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

cases.sentence: Мерзость была совершена в Израиле и в Иерусалиме: Иуда осквернил святилище Господа, которое Он любит, женившись на дочери ___.
cases.explain: «чужого бога» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

cases.sentence: Ты был ей неверен, хотя она твоя супруга, твоя ___.
cases.explain: «законная жена» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion, and the wife of your covenant.
